recognition: 2002isolated rule; one recognized/one unrecognized,declared positive or negative association; lower criterion inverts explicit higher comparison. Unknown/both/neither abstain.
ttb: 1996recognition precedence requires positive ecological direction and higher criterion. No negative-recognition import from2002.
ranking: Cue validities decimal strings[.5,1] with positive orientation; supplied list must descend in validity and ascend integer rank. Equal validities require tie_policy=frozen_order,otherwise abstain before search. Provenance/training periods mandatory. No learning/reordering.
probability: Exact plain decimal string 0..1,up to100digits and100fractional places;no exponents,spaces,leading+,booleans orJSONnumbers. Fraction arithmetic. Output reduced rational string and rounded12-place decimal using HALF_EVEN.
chronology: Cutoff inclusive; forecast original/amendment timestamp must precede actual occurrence strictly,knowledge false. Original at<=subsequent amendment and global action time. Resolution at>=occurrence/publication/discovery;unknown times stay unknown. Window closed,occurrence must be inside. Publication/discovery are distinct and do not substitute for occurrence.
selection: Select latest temporally eligible version per planned slot/forecaster/event,horizon fixed by plan;equal-time versions resolved by append sequence. Late/known-outcome amendments retained/excluded and cannot displace eligible original. Event definitions/slots/baseline frozen at create;one slot per forecaster/event.
evidence: Resolved requires local bytes matching SHA256 plus holder,permission,provenance. Missing evidence retained/unscored. Evidence bytes checked on every replay;no asset bytes exported. Unresolved/disputed/void unscored.
calibration: Ten bins[0,.1),...,[.9,1],using exact submitted probabilities,no midpoint replacement;empty frequencies null. Per-bin unscored selected counts;always N. No decomposition/inference.
baseline: Optional constant training prevalence frozen before plan;training ends before freeze;distinct event IDs,matching domain,horizon,event definition,verified local evidence;probability must equal mean training outcomes. No evaluation IDs in training. Same eligible resolved pairs,paired loss difference only;BSS/logloss deferred.
records: Local hash chain detects mismatch against retained root only;owner may rewrite entire ledger. Identity,clock,knowledge,training validity and rights remain declarations;no trusted timestamp or empirical skill certification.
